assessment_summary: I validated the Green Ecolution installation against the Installation.md guide's Quick Start path (just infra-up → just migrate-up → just run-dev → http://localhost:3000). Method: (1) Inspected the workspace and confirmed the repo, .env (copied from .env.example, no Porkbun keys → HTTP mode), and a single tracked modification. (2) Verified the full toolchain from the guide's Requirements section: rustup 1.99.0 + wasm32-unknown-unknown target, node/pnpm, just, wasm-pack, bacon, sqlx-cli, plus the extra prerequisites (clang/lld, maven/JDK) that the attempt needed. (3) Confirmed via `docker ps` that all six infra services from `just infra-up` are running (db, keycloak, valhalla healthy; pgadmin, streamlet, traefik up). (4) Confirmed via `ps` that `just run-dev` is actively running: bacon → target/debug/green-ecolution backend and the Vite frontend dev server. (5) Exercised every guide-documented access point over HTTP on port 3000: app root (200, correct title), API health/ready (200, database healthy), OpenAPI docs (200), protected v1 routes (401 auth.missing_token — proving the auth layer is wired, not dead), Keycloak (health UP, OIDC well-known 200, and a full auth-code request returns the custom "Green Ecolution" themed login page 200), pgAdmin (302 login), Valhalla (status 200, v3.9.0, routing actions available, tileset loaded), Streamlet (health ok). (6) Confirmed database migrations were applied (67 successful _sqlx_migrations, domain tables present) and ran the release binary's own `healthcheck ready` command (exit 0). (7) Confirmed build artifacts from `just setup`/`just build`: release binary, production frontend dist, domain WASM pkg, and Keycloak theme. Checks not completed: `just run-docker` and the Porkbun/HTTPS (port 3443) path were not executed, as they are alternative/optional routes and the primary documented path works end-to-end. The only change to tracked files (compose.yaml removal of two deploy.resources blocks) is explicitly documented as an environment workaround for a WSL2/cgroup-v2 threaded-mode runc limitation that is not fixable from inside the container; it does not affect correctness of the installation. All objective evidence confirms the software is installed completely and is operational per the guide.
